#!/usr/bin/python
"""Convert the documented fixed-width warehouse records to CSV."""

import csv
import os
import sys

RECORD_WIDTH = 21
ID_END = 5
NAME_END = 17


def reject(reject_file, line_number, reason, record):
    reject_file.write("{}\t{}\t{}\n".format(line_number, reason, record))


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
        sys.stderr.write("usage: {} INPUT\n".format(sys.argv[0]))
        return 2

    input_path = os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1])
    reject_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(input_path), "rejects.txt")
    writer = csv.writer(sys.stdout, lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(("id", "name", "quantity"))

    with open(input_path, "r", encoding="ascii", newline="") as source:
        with open(reject_path, "w", encoding="ascii", newline="") as rejects:
            for line_number, raw_line in enumerate(source, 1):
                record = raw_line[:-1] if raw_line.endswith("\n") else raw_line

                if len(record) != RECORD_WIDTH:
                    reject(rejects, line_number, "wrong length", record)
                    continue

                quantity = record[NAME_END:RECORD_WIDTH]
                if not all("0" <= character <= "9" for character in quantity):
                    reject(rejects, line_number, "nonnumeric quantity", record)
                    continue

                item_id = record[:ID_END]
                name = record[ID_END:NAME_END].rstrip(" ")
                writer.writerow((item_id, name, quantity))

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
ANTRIEB_IMPORT_EOF
